Combined with the causes of the climate on the west coast of Europe, the North Atlantic Warm Current has a warming effect on the coast, and the prevailing westerlies also bring warm and humid air from the ocean to the land of Western Europe, so the temperature anomaly on the west coast of the Eurasian continent is relatively large.
